text:
Izzy: quick check — changelog cutoff is tomorrow 3pm PT. please have final user-visible PRs (sdk/docs/sampleapps) merged or flagged. i can assemble the notes after cutoff. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Mike L: noted. i have 2 sdk merges blocked on reviews (client-go + python auth shim). @sophia can you do a quick pass on client-go? i can merge python once CI green.

Sophia: yes i can review client-go today, aiming for EOD PT. docs freeze is earlier: noon PT. translators already warned. so docs PRs must land before 12:00 PT or they'll miss the cut.

Raj: sampleapp e2e failing on auth mock after dependency bump. failing test snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: Expected token expiry > now
requests_mock.exceptions.NoMockAddress: Unhandled request: POST http://auth.internal/v1/token
```
I tried reverting the auth client but still flakes. pinging @kyle for dep compatibility.

Kyle: that auth change in infra bumped the client to 2.1.0 which changed the behavior of token refresh. sampleapps need a small shim. I can patch the sampleapp and open a PR today (ETA 2 hours).

Jen: changelog assembly notes — please drop a one-line description in your PR body following the template: `component: short description (user impact)` e.g. `sdk-python: add streaming response helper (no breaking changes)` . I'll harvest after cutoff and create the consolidated changelog PR.

Mike L: CI status — python sdk build is queued, client-go PR reported flaky integration tests. @CI Bot any more details?

CI Bot: python-sdk #342 queued on runner-5, estimated start ~10m. client-go #217 failed integration-aws-setup (timeout on terraform apply). Retries automated (1/2). See https://ci.internal/runs/342 and https://ci.internal/runs/217

Izzy: thanks. real quick ownerships to confirm: changelog assembly = Jen, docs freeze enforcement = Sophia, sdk merges = Mike L, sampleapp fixes = Kyle, e2e infra escalation = Raj. if anyone can't make their part speak up now.

Sophia: can own docs freeze enforcement but need a follow-up from translations (ETA 6pm PT) — if translators miss batch we should still merge minor non-user-visible docs changes post-cutoff.

Kyle: will open sampleapp patch in ~30m and mark it `needs-review` — @mike please prioritize merge once CI passes; it's just a small shim.

Mike L: will prioritize. if client-go review blocks, tag me and i'll pair-review. also sprinkling in a canary publish after changelog PR merges — want to validate package indexing before full release.

Jen: perfect. i'll create a changelog PR at 15:15 PT with collected lines and tag everyone for final thumbs. please double-check your PR bodies.

Izzy: great. last question — do we need a doc blurb for the sampleapp auth shim? or just a changelog note?

Raj: small blurb would be helpful for platform teams. i'll draft a 2-line note and add to docs PR queue.

Izzy: awesome. i'll check back at 11:30 PT for a quick status ping. thanks all :rocket:
